digest_over: Every regular file under `bundle`, in ascending order of its bundle-relative POSIX path compared as UTF-8 bytes, as the lines `<sha256 hex of the file's bytes>  <path>\n`, themselves hashed with sha256. The sort is explicit so the answer does not depend on the order a filesystem walk returns; the path is in the digest beside the content so a rename moves it; the hex digest is fixed-width and the separator is literal, so a rename and an edit cannot cancel. Reproducible without this repository's code: `cd <bundle> && find . -type f | sed 's|^\./||' | LC_ALL=C sort | tr '\n' '\0' | xargs -0 sha256sum | sha256sum`.
